authority: Static House Tang administrative program rules. This file registers lawful program templates and treasury-safety policy; it does not prove that any campaign program has been accepted or opened.

treasury_safety.rule: A new discretionary House program may receive at most the registered fraction of cash remaining after the protected stable-expense reserve. Opening a program reserves no money and spends nothing by itself.

field_preparation.rule: An explicitly requested House Tang campaign-preparation stage may load at most the registered departure reserve from exact House stores. Military field subsistence is a derived strategic-supply condition, not a stored commodity. It may form already-conserved Tang Wei personal-force manpower and issue only exact registered stock. Missing equipment remains a persisted shortfall rather than being manufactured by narration.

house_tang_military_replacement_intake.rule: Replacement intake fills only real vacancies from conserved population and is bounded by assessment throughput, standard equipment, cavalry harness, remounts, and the ordinary House training clock.

house_tang_command_cadre.rule: Persistent 500+ command billets require distinct exact named characters; officer is a billet/career appointment, never a troop species or promotion outcome.
